title: AI Operational Backbone
description: Automated production workflows connecting AI models, brief intake forms, CRM, and real-time asset delivery pipelines.
overview: Architected an automated multi-branch operational backbone for a creative studio to eliminate manual handoffs between client brief and production kickoff.
challenge: Team members spent 35% of their working hours manually copy-pasting client creative briefs, transcribing audio, and drafting project proposals.
solution: Built an autonomous webhook orchestration in n8n connecting Typeform briefs to Gemini 2.5 Flash for instant brief synthesis, Airtable for task distribution, and Slack for alerts.
